statements: No statutory instrument can be identified as made under section 117 of the Education (Scotland) Act 1962, because no retrieved source connects any instrument to that enabling power, so no instrument should be listed as made under it.
The Education (Scotland) Act 1962 could not be retrieved from the available legislation sources, so the terms of its section 117 were never read and nothing should be asserted about them.
The Education (Scotland) Act 1962 is a different statute from the Education (Scotland) Act 1980 that superseded it, and an answer about section 117 of the 1980 Act does not answer this question.
